_note: The example sentence in German, with the English headword rendered in German too.
Seven quotations stay English because they ARE the specimen - the ambiguity of
'Visiting relatives can be tiring', the redundancy of 'It is what it is', the bad
grammar of 'Between you and I'. Those exist in English and nowhere else, so a
translation of them shows the reader nothing. Reported speech is translated.
Two headwords are unchanged because the German word IS the English one: Mathesis
and Imbroglio are both in Duden. Ersatz, Seneschall, Sybarit, Paroxysmus and
Soloezismus are German too but spelled differently, so they need no exemption.
